description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) capability wrapper for addon-provided MCP executors. Concrete transport lives in conductor-mcp, not base engine. Mirrors engine/capabilities/mcp.py::MCPCapability.
instructions: Wraps an MCP executor as a Conductor Engine capability.
Connection and session management is handled by the conductor-mcp addon package.
Core engine provides the Capability seam. MCP transport is addon-owned.
